no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the betrixaban (BEVYXXA) NDA. The Risk review notes that at the February 7, 2017 mid-cycle meeting the Agency informed the Applicant there were no safety issues requiring a REMS and there was no plan for an Advisory Committee meeting; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader, Medical, and Summary reviews all confirm no committee was held because there were no issues requiring discussion. Consequently there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
